description_en: Lists the AccessKey pairs of a specified user
description_zh: 调用ListAccessKeys接口列出指定用户的访问密钥
name: ListAccessKeys

parameters.help_en: The username. If a Resource Access Management (RAM) user calls this operation without specifying this parameter, the AccessKey pairs of the RAM user are listed
parameters.help_zh: 指定用户，RAM用户访问时不提供此参数则表示列出自己的访问密钥
parameters.name: user_name
